craft_notes: Sthāyin: adbhuta-vīra of the Lord's array, limb by limb — weapon-and-ensign song. Bearing-shows; opposed-yet-unopposed-in-me hinge. Rejected: (a) resolving hinge → killed: hinge is the verse. Read aloud: FIRE, WA-ter, NEC-tar-STREAK, POI-son … NOT-this.

lines: Fire, water, nectar-streak, poison — bearing, You show this;
world opposed though — in true-knowing-formed, in me unopposed — not this.
l4.sanskrit_cite: dahanajalāmṛtalekhāviṣādi bibhrat tvam ādiśasy etat | viśvaṃ viruddham api saccidrūpe mayi virudhyate naitat

reads_against.argmap: What opposes, unopposed? → Bearing pointed; opposed-in-me unopposed.
c1_essence: Borne pointed; opposed unopposed in me.
Impassioned cloth cast; bloodied hide told.
Dagger bared splitting; taken-world heroes best.
Noosed time counted; death's death shown.
Hurled to unmake; goad makes plain.
Bow shown, lords arrayed; cause-deer deer-pierced.
